checking.title: Confirming your payment…
checking.body: Your payment has been submitted. We are confirming the result with the payment provider. This usually takes a few seconds. Please do not close this page.

success.title: Payment successful
success.body: Your payment has been received and your request has been submitted for processing.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.body: Your payment could not be completed. No amount has been charged. You can try again with the same or a different card.
failed.genericReason: The payment was declined by the card issuer.

unconfirmed.title: Payment result not yet confirmed
unconfirmed.body: We could not confirm the result of this payment yet. If your payment was completed, it will be credited automatically. Please do not pay again — check the Payments section for the latest status.

invalid.title: This payment link is not valid
invalid.body: We could not find a payment matching this link. Please check the Payments section for your recent payments.
